item_short_desc: Rothco’s 3-Point Rifle Sling offers secure and versatile firearm carry with its universal design, featuring multiple attachment points to fit most rifles. Built with durable poly webbing, this sling ensures long-lasting performance and resistance to wear. The 1.25 inch wide straps provide a comfortable and sturdy carry, while the adjustable shoulder straps allow you to customize the fit for optimal convenience during extended use.
